note.text: Medical-to-dental referral created in Epic at the well-child visit and routed through Connie (Connecticut's statewide HIE) to BeneCare (the CTDHP ASO), whose Plan-Net directory identifies Dr. Watson at Cornell Scott-Hill Health Center (HUSKY B, accepting new patients, within 20 miles). This is a referral for a COVERED evaluation, not a treatment order: no CRD/prior-authorization fires here (the dental benefit is confirmed active); CRD — and DTR/PAS via Gainwell if a planned procedure needs it — applies at the treatment visit, not at referral. The scheduled appointment is 2026-05-28, three months out. No imaging accompanies this referral: UC03 involves no radiographs/DICOM at referral time (unlike UC01/UC02); the receiving practice will capture any imaging in-office.
